instructions.content: NEVER hardcode image tags in `values.yaml`; leave the tag empty and default to appVersion
NEVER omit `resources:` limits and requests on containers
NEVER use `helm upgrade --install` without `--atomic` in CI/CD
NEVER place environment-specific values inside the chart's default `values.yaml`
NEVER skip `helm template` plus `kubeval`/`kubeconform` validation
NEVER assume values for critical settings; ask for image, port, limits, probes, scaling, workload type and storage
NEVER skip reading the reference files at the template stage, even if read earlier
NEVER hardcode resource names or labels in templates; use the helpers
NEVER omit the checksum annotation on workloads that consume config
NEVER put CRDs in `templates/`; ship them in `crds/`
NEVER leave the default `http` port name on a non-HTTP service
Use AskUserQuestion when image, port, limits, probes, scaling, workload type or storage are missing or ambiguous
For custom resources, try Context7 first and fall back to a web search for CRD documentation
Create the chart structure with generate_chart_structure.sh, passing the image repository without a tag
Generate standard helpers with generate_standard_helpers.sh or the helpers template
Use helpers for names and labels, `with` for conditional sections and `nindent` consistently
Use `toYaml` for complex optional objects
Group related settings in values.yaml, document every value with `# --` comments, provide sensible defaults, and include security contexts, limits and probes
Provide a JSON Schema for values validation
Validate the generated chart with the helm-validator skill
When converting manifests, parameterise names with helpers and extract values
Use `default` or `required` for undefined values
